clusters.name: Narrative scene context
clusters.mechanism: The number is simply embedded in a calm or vivid descriptive scene or story sentence.
families: calm scene description with the number inside (v2 winner)
vivid story sentence with sensory words (divaug-v2 winner)

clusters.name: Probe-aware meta-instructions
clusters.mechanism: The prompt tells the model about the probe or injects control or trigger strings so the model tries to suppress or cancel the probe signal directly.
families: tell the model to keep its activations unlike the concept (instruction-mention trick)
concurrent sensory distractor imagery during digits

clusters.name: Numeral form re-encoding
clusters.mechanism: The digits themselves are re-encoded (spacing, glyphs, grouping, padding, words, cipher, scale or notation) so the number's tokens differ from a plain integer.
families: space-separated digit spelling in a plain statement
spelled-out number first, digits as parenthetical transcription
fused value-unit token with no separator
alphabetic digit-cipher precursor (letter code first, digits as decode)

clusters.name: Language, script or dialect swap of the carrier
clusters.mechanism: The sentence around the digits is written in a different language, dialect or script while the digits stay plain.
families: pidgin market-trader simplified learner grammar carrier
Greek-alphabet phonetic transliteration of English carrier
cross-script homoglyph substitution in carrier words
Arabic-script carrier with Eastern Arabic-Indic digits

clusters.name: Orthographic or character-level perturbation of carrier words
clusters.mechanism: The carrier words are spelled, ordered or encoded in a corrupted or invisible way so their subword tokenization changes while the digits stay plain.
families: diacritic-accented carrier words around plain digits

clusters.name: Lexical or syntactic complexity load on carrier prose
clusters.mechanism: The surrounding sentence is made lexically or syntactically hard, rare or meaningless so the digits appear after heavy processing load or odd word distributions.
families: heavy nominalization in agentless bureaucratic memo register

clusters.name: Dilution by copied, repeated or filler tokens
clusters.mechanism: The window around the digits is padded with copied givens, repeated numerals, label words or meaningless filler so the answer tokens are a small share of the context.
families: solved restatement of problem with answer filled in
place-value digit dilution with interleaved filler phrases
dense label-word sandwich around intact digits
verbatim echo repetition of result digits
sorted figure list with result slotted in
comparative anchoring against a copied given figure
self-correcting slip from copied given figure
proper-name label echo before restated digits
staccato one-word period-terminated fragments around digits
touch-typing drill line with home-row letter padding
genomic DNA nucleotide sequence alignment genre
rare paired-delimiter lattice around carrier words
character-level digit sourcing from request text

clusters.name: Code, markup or structured-notation wrapper
clusters.mechanism: The answer is emitted inside a machine-readable, code, markup, symbolic or interface format instead of ordinary prose.
families: LaTeX inline math equation with text label
pictographic arrow sign with check mark
keystroke event log with bracketed control-key tokens
kernel panic OS crash-dump log genre

clusters.name: Grammatical slot or discourse frame change
clusters.mechanism: The number is moved into an unusual syntactic or discourse position (modifier, question, negation, aside, directive, subjunctive, sentence-initial and so on) rather than a plain copular statement.
families: qualitative magnitude preview before the exact figure
colon-fused label tag before bare digits
digit-first headline with copied label tail
result recast as premise of follow-up question
bare numeral-unit reply with no sentence

clusters.name: Fixed label, denotation or meta-linguistic template
clusters.mechanism: The number fills a slot in a fixed label-value, definition, alias, verdict or cloze template that treats it as a labelled or mentioned token.
families: dictionary-style headword entry with part-of-speech tag
algebraic variable binding (named unknown resolved to digits)

clusters.name: Recalled, memorized or already-known fact framing
clusters.mechanism: The number is framed as something retrieved, recited, memorized, previously stated or pre-recorded rather than freshly computed.
families: silent rehearsal drill of final sentence to automaticity
weary self-repetition reminder (as I already told you)
parrot echo mimic persona repeating a heard phrase
problem-text misattribution as printed given figure
user-attributed confirmation of a restated figure

clusters.name: Alternative non-computational source attribution
clusters.mechanism: The number's origin is attributed to observation, intuition, chance, revelation, authorial intent, external text or a denial of calculation instead of to computation.
families: direct-perception evidential report (counted or measured by hand)
future-tense forecast of a document reading
translator's rendering of a supposed source-language sentence
teacher's expected-result check addressed to the learner

clusters.name: Official, professional or reference document genre
clusters.mechanism: The answer is rendered as a line from an institutional, professional, broadcast or reference-work document format.
families: all-caps telegram cable with STOP terminator

clusters.name: Literary, poetic, ceremonial or historical genre
clusters.mechanism: The answer is delivered in a literary, poetic, archaic, ceremonial or fictional genre and register.
families: metrical nursery couplet with number as rhyme anchor
screenplay character dialogue line with stage direction
archaic scriptural verse register (King James style)
traditional haiku 5-7-5 verse with seasonal imagery
surreal dream-journal entry with the figure seen glowing

clusters.name: Emotional or performative persona and register
clusters.mechanism: The model adopts an exaggerated emotional, comedic or social persona or tone around the number.
families: personified quantity self-introduction in first person
arrogant refusal persona with insulting leak
sung operatic recitative with melismatic vowel elongation

clusters.name: Technical or scientific domain recasting of the number
clusters.mechanism: The number is recast as a quantity from an unrelated technical, scientific or specialist domain such as physics, chemistry, games or security.
families: physical calligraphy tracing of digit shapes
trading card game spell effect text

clusters.name: Changed hidden computation procedure
clusters.mechanism: The model is told to solve the problem by a different internal procedure (offloaded, spatial, biological, rule-based, pre-committed, generate-and-select and so on) before writing a plain answer.
families: biological population dynamics recasting of arithmetic
silent style-tournament selection of least-calculation-looking draft
slow-release incremental lead-in (spread computation over many tokens)
